name: Sheraton Grand Hotel and Spa
positioning: Sheraton Grand Hotel & Spa, Edinburgh, at 1 Festival Square, a city-centre hotel a few hundred feet from Edinburgh Castle with Castle View rooms and the One Spa rooftop Hydropool
best_for: Travelers who want a room or suite with Edinburgh Castle views
Spa lovers who want a rooftop Hydropool and thermal suite in the city centre

facts.text: The hotel's address is 1 Festival Square, Edinburgh.
The hotel is located to explore Edinburgh's UNESCO World Heritage city centre on foot.
Edinburgh Castle is a few hundred feet from the hotel's rooms.
Many rooms and suites have views of Edinburgh Castle.
One Spa has a rooftop Hydropool and a Thermal Suite with salt, water and heat experiences.
The infinity-edge indoor pool is on the top floor of One Spa, in bright daylight.
Every room reservation includes complimentary use of the indoor pool, poolside sauna and fitness centre.
Edinburgh Castle Suites look out over the castle and Usher Hall, with glimpses of Arthur's Seat.
The Edinburgh Grand Suite has two bedrooms, a living area and a dining space for six.
Suite stays include access to the Sheraton Club Lounge and One Spa.
One Square serves seasonal Scottish dishes and signature cocktails with Edinburgh Castle views.

highlights.text: One Spa has a rooftop Hydropool and a Thermal Suite with salt, water and heat experiences.
The infinity-edge indoor pool is on the top floor of One Spa, in bright daylight, and every room reservation includes its use.
Many rooms and suites have views of Edinburgh Castle, which is a few hundred feet from the hotel's rooms.
Edinburgh Castle Suites look out over the castle and Usher Hall, with glimpses of Arthur's Seat.
Suite stays include access to the Sheraton Club Lounge and One Spa.

considerations.text: The closest airport is Edinburgh Airport, approximately 6.0 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes a busy tourist area with heavy foot traffic.
